brief: 6 internal tools every AI startup ships in week 1 — concrete examples.

slots.title: 1. Prompt Lab, the sandbox
slots.body: A shared workspace to version-test system prompts against real inputs. Prevents regression when models update.

slots.title: 2. Ingest Pipe, the memory
slots.body: Chunks product docs and Slack exports, embeds them into pgvector, and refreshes the index every night.

slots.title: 3. Slack Bot, the oracle
slots.body: Answers employee questions using RAG over internal Notion pages. Lives in a private #ai-support channel.

slots.title: 4. Eval Queue, the filter
slots.body: Routes 10% of production LLM outputs into a daily human review board. Flags hallucinations and regressions.

slots.title: 5. Cost Guard, the meter
slots.body: Tracks per-feature token spend by model and user. Pings Slack when experiments exceed a $50 budget.

slots.title: 6. Sync Scribe, the archive
slots.body: Records standups, writes structured tickets, and updates the wiki. Surfaces decisions in search.

slots.headline: Build Your Week-1 Stack
slots.subline: Save this checklist and ship your internal AI toolkit before your next standup.
